deadline.value: January 1 deadline for full consideration for Fall admission
deadline.quote: For full consideration, applications must be received by January 1.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are optional but may be submitted as an additional demonstration of preparedness.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are optional but may be submitted as an additional means to demonstrate academic preparedness.

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no Computer Science subject test.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Mentorship with a faculty research advisor is central, with direct research groups.
supervisor.quote: The program emphasizes self-directed study, independent inquiry, and close mentorship with a faculty research advisor.

funding.value: All Ph.D. students receive financial aid through research or teaching assistantships with stipends, tuition coverage, and health insurance.
funding.quote: The UConn College of Engineering offers competitive financial support for Ph.D. students, including stipends, full tuition coverage, and health insurance. | All Ph.D. students receive financial aid through research assistantships (RAs) or teaching assistantships (TAs), which provide a stipend based on the assistantship type and department.

entry_route.value: Direct admission beyond the bachelor's degree.
entry_route.quote: Can I apply directly to the Ph.D. Program without an MS degree? | Yes.
